title: pcell-multilevel adds containment: the self-made wall holds the heritable catalyst particles at >= 90x, daughters inherit them, and low-yield cells die (S,I,W,D,H)
summary: Same world and runs as 20261025T0820-c06-pcell-multilevel-claim (catalyst particles carrying a heritable link yield inside Allen-Cahn cells, cy=0.03), now with the containment gate measured and ablated. Every cell holds its particles at >= 92x the density in a shell 2-6 px outside, at every check from t=1000 to t=20000 on seeds 0 and 1 (median effectively infinite: the shell is empty), and 93-95% of all particles are inside cells. At 1.5x resolution (192^2, lengths and diffusivities scaled) 25 cells hold >= 56x (median ~1000x). With the phi^2 reflection gate removed at the same DK no cell survives past t~1100. A matched lowered-D twin (gate off, DK/10) still holds 4-37x in the weakest cell but its cells coarsen and fuse into one giant body: 18 -> 4 and 11 -> 5 cells, 0 and 5 persistent splits (W/pack_lowD). Division partitions the particles, so daughters inherit both contents and yield (r = 0.86-0.97), and selection acts through intrinsic deaths (mature-cell deaths at the 3rd-5th yield percentile, 82/82 below the median over 3 seeds; inert marker 0.29-0.55).

claims.statement: In pcell-multilevel from an unstructured start, discrete walled cells form, hold the catalyst particles that make their wall at >= 92x the outside for their whole lives (W/c_world_s*.json), divide so that each daughter inherits a share of the particles and with them the parent's heritable yield (parent-daughter r 0.86-0.97), and the low-yield cells die of starvation beside high-yield neighbours (82/82 mature-cell deaths below the median yield, mean percentile 0.03-0.05) while an identical-event inert marker shows no such bias on 2 of 3 seeds.
claims.track: seed 0, labkit track 65 (research/alife/collective/contrib/20261025T0820-c06-pcell-multilevel-claim/pack/seed0/tracks.png, lineage.png): generation 4 (31 -> 43 -> 58 -> 60 -> 65), born t=67000, its particles sealed inside its wall (particles.png) until t=100000

controls_run.W: W/c_gate0_s0.json (phi^2 reflection gate off: no cells after t~1100); W/c_lowD_s*.json and W/pack_lowD/ (gate off, DK/10: contrast kept while bodies last, but cells fuse 18 -> 4 and 11 -> 5); W/c_res15_s0.json and W/pack_res15/ (1.5x resolution, >= 56x)
controls_run.H: research/alife/collective/contrib/20261025T0820-c06-pcell-multilevel-claim/data/selection.txt: identical-event inert marker z in the same three runs

claims.bd_control: W/pack_lowD (gate replaced by a uniformly lowered particle diffusivity, DK/10): the contrast survives (weakest cell 4-37x) but discrete cells and divisions are lost (fusion into one body, 0-5 persistent splits), so the gate is needed for I and D at W, not for the contrast alone
claims.limits: All limits of 20261025T0820-c06-pcell-multilevel-claim apply (continuous trait ranks as kinds; mean yield change within the marker's drift; seed-2 marker bias; buds below 20% recorded as new cells; one cost value; no dt test). Containment is of discrete particles by a reflection rule (Metropolis acceptance phi_new^2/phi_old^2), so particles cannot leak by diffusion by construction of the gate; the measured ratio counts particles 2-6 px outside each cell. The lowered-D twin was run 20000 t on 2 seeds only. B is not claimed: raising the wall adsorption to chi=2.5 leaves the L ring at rim/core 1.38-1.46, and chi >= 3 kills the cells (W/../ not packed; seeds 0-1, 8000 t).
